titulo: Jason Showers in His Underwear in the Japanese Version of GTA 6, but Censorship Is Nothing New for Rockstar Games
texto: GTA 6 is finally here, but for players in Japan the experience is looking a bit different. Pre-release concerns about censorship have proven to be founded, with blood, gore, and nudity getting dialed down, but also some more surprising changes.

titulo: Players Are Surprised at How Well the Xbox Series S Handles GTA 6
texto: In the run-up to GTA 6's launch, one of the biggest questions was how well the Xbox Series S would handle the game. And, now that it's out in the wild, and actually runs the game pretty well, Series S owners are celebrating.

titulo: An Estimated 2 Million Eager Xbox Gamers Made Use of the 'New Zealand Trick' to Play GTA 6 Early
texto: Enough people to fill a third of New Zealand’s population changed their console settings to play GTA 6 a day early. Dubbed the “New Zealand trick,” the exploit saw players change their region to appear as if they were in another country where the clock struck midnight earliest.
